name: veltriva
description: A local-first, Chromium-powered desktop browser that manages inactive tabs and keeps a searchable local tab memory.
author: Raymond Valdepeñas

scripts.setup: npm ci && node node_modules/electron/install.js && node scripts/verify-sqlite-binary.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:test && node scripts/check-data-isolation.mjs && playwright test
scripts.test:lifecycle: npm run build:test && vitest run --config vitest.lifecycle.config.mts
scripts.bench:memory: npm run build:test && vitest run --config vitest.benchmark.config.mts memory
scripts.bench:search: npm run build:test && vitest run --config vitest.benchmark.config.mts search
scripts.docs:images: npm run build:test && playwright test -c playwright.docs-images.config.ts
scripts.build:release: node scripts/verify-sqlite-binary.mjs && electron-vite build && node scripts/check-production-build.mjs && node scripts/check-data-isolation.mjs && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs --check
scripts.package:dir: npm run build:release && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir && node scripts/check-packaged-app.mjs
scripts.package:installer: npm run build:release && electron-builder --win --x64 && node scripts/check-packaged-app.mjs
